notes: Every basis_ref carries its provenance tier in text: APPROVED_SOURCE for the exchange rule text, OWNER_RISK_ACCEPTED for the owner-accepted additions. basis_status only says admitted-vs-not-admitted; the tier is never inferred from it.
R9 (rounding = HALF_UP) is a property of every price-limit row, so each row names its clause instead of adding a separate rule row.

The exact document URL, fetch time and byte sha256 live in the private A-7 evidence report (#395); they are not reproduced here because this repository does not redistribute the exchange rule text (D-44 (4)).
R7 is NOT_AVAILABLE: no price-limit row starts before 1996-12-16, so a derivation before that day is rule_missing/unknown. There is no 'no limit' wildcard and the loader rejects an earlier row.
Rows are effective-dated facts, not a time series: effective_to is exclusive.

R2 before 2023-02-17 is encoded as five rows (D-64): the 1998 starts are OWNER_RISK_ACCEPTED (SZ: the exchange name-change table's first ST event plus a .day anchor count; SH: .day only, because D-58 leaves pre-2000 SH ST status NOT_AVAILABLE), while the 2006/2011/2013/2020-12 segments are APPROVED_SOURCE with their clause numbers. Encoding a start the owner accepted is not 'today's rule over history'; the tier says which part is clause text.

R6 first-day segments without any daily band before 2023-02-17 are encoded as band_side=none, i.e. a known Unbounded answer rather than unknown. The 44%/36% declared-range segments (SH from 2013-12-13, SZ from 2014-06-13) stay not_encoded until a two-band schema and an admitted issue-price source exist.
This file is data: a content change publishes a new derived:trading_rules version, so snapshot_id names the decision that authorised the content (D-64, 2026-10-29).

not_available.reason: No exchange archive text exists for the 1990-1996 Shanghai band changes: the deprecated rule library (443 enumerable documents), the announcement index and the current rule library (earliest version 2006) contain no such rule or notice. Per D-44 (3), derivations before 1996-12-16 return unknown; 'no price limit' is forbidden as a fallback. Evidence: #395 comment 2026-10-26, D-44/D-59.

not_encoded.reason: These segments are an asymmetric declared price range (144%/64%, i.e. +44%/-36%) measured from the issue price, not from a previous close. One band_bp + band_side cannot express an asymmetric range: 4400 as up_only would report the down side as unbounded and 3600 as band_bp would understate the up side. limit-v1 keys on a previous close that a listing day does not have, and the inner session ranges (opening auction 120%/80%, SZ intraday +-10% of the last trade) are a further layer. The issue-price source (G-7) is not admitted. The segments stay rule_missing/unknown until a two-band schema with price_basis/band_kind and an issue-price source exists (D-64).

An SH risk-warning stock whose previous close is <= 0.10 yuan uses a one-tick band instead of the percentage band. The rule rows can only say 'at least one tick' once the nullable min_band_ticks column exists, which is the M3 schema 25 change (D-64); this PR does not touch the table shape. Until that column lands, a derived limit for such a bar is the percentage-band answer and must be read as approximate.
